description_en: Modifies the configuration of a VPC firewall for a transit router. Prerequisites: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) Enterprise Edition transit router → Create a VPC firewall for the transit router by calling CreateTrFirewallV2 → Obtain the FirewallId and then call this operation
description_zh: 修改TR防火墙配置。【前置依赖】CEN 企业版转发路由器 → CreateTrFirewallV2 创建 TR 防火墙 → 获取 FirewallId 后调用本 API
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-tr-firewall-v2-configuration --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-bcdf89d405ce4bd20000 --firewall-name vpc-firewall --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTrFirewallV2Configuration

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall. You can call DescribeTrFirewallsV2List to obtain the ID.

Note: FirewallId and FirewallName are jointly required. Both parameters must be provided at the same time. If either parameter is missing, the operation returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
VPC 边界防火墙实例 ID。可通过 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 获取。

注意：FirewallId 与 FirewallName 联合必填，两个参数必须同时提供，任一参数缺失时接口返回 400 错误
parameters.name: firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance name of the VPC firewall.

Note: FirewallId and FirewallName are jointly required. Both parameters must be provided at the same time. If either parameter is missing, the operation returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
VPC 边界防火墙实例名。

注意：FirewallId 与 FirewallName 联合必填，两个参数必须同时提供，任一参数缺失时接口返回 400 错误
parameters.name: firewall_name
